facts: Parties: Hartwell Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Bellhaven Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Arden Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 17 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 4 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 17 June 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 8.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $15,937,500. The Purchase Price is $85,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Thornbury Analytics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 29 September 2026.
